title: GRAFT: Execution-Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.23509v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated agent design searches for executable architectures that improve LLM-based agent performance, with evolutionary methods using language-model crossover to recombine promising mechanisms for task decomposition, model coordination, and verification. This search, however, is typically guided by aggregate fitness alone, which hides the instance-level successes and failures behind each score. We introduce Execution Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design (GRAFT), which uses aggregate fitness for selection and survival and parent-specific execution evidence to guide semantic crossover with integrated mutation. Its feedback harness reuses bounded samples of successful and failed runs from fitness evaluation, withholding reference answers and requiring no additional task executions. We evaluate GRAFT across six reasoning and programming settings using open-weight optimizer and executor models. It achieves a mean test accuracy of 82

translated_title: GRAFT：面向智能体设计的执行引导式基因重组
translated_abstract: 自动智能体设计旨在搜索能够提升基于LLM的智能体性能的可执行架构，其中进化方法使用语言模型交叉来重组有前景的机制，以实现任务分解、模型协调和验证。然而，这种搜索通常仅由聚合适应度分数引导，这掩盖了每个分数背后的实例级成功与失败信息。我们提出了面向智能体设计的执行引导式基因重组（GRAFT），该方法使用聚合适应度进行选择和存活判定，同时利用父代特有的执行证据来指导融合了变异的语义交叉。其反馈框架复用适应度评估中有界数量的成功与失败运行样本，无需提供参考答案，也不需要额外的任务执行。我们使用开放权重的优化器模型和执行器模型，在六个推理和编程场景中评估了GRAFT，它实现了平均82（摘要原文在此处截断）的测试准确率。
tldr: GRAFT提出了一种执行引导的遗传重组方法，在进化式智能体设计中利用父代任务执行的成功与失败证据来引导语义交叉与变异，而不仅依赖聚合适应度分数，从而在不额外执行任务的情况下提升LLM智能体架构的搜索效果。
en_tdlr: GRAFT introduces an execution-guided genetic recombination method for evolutionary agent design, which leverages parent-specific execution evidence from fitness evaluation—rather than aggregate fitness alone—to guide semantic crossover with mutation, improving LLM-based agent architectures without additional task executions.
